description.zh:
域控主机名。
必须符合Windows主机命名规范。
description.en: The hostname of the domain controller. The hostname must comply with the naming conventions for hostnames in Windows.
The name of the AD directory.

description.zh: 企业AD对应DNS的IP地址。目前仅支持设置一个。请确保该IP地址在所选的交换机网络下可以访问。
description.en: The IP address of the DNS server corresponding to the enterprise AD. You can specify only one IP address. Make sure that the specified IP address is accessible in the network of the selected vSwitch.

description.zh: 域名称。长度为2~255个字符，格式为两段式域名，如：`example.com`。相同的域名只能注册一次。
description.en: The domain name. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length and must be in the two-part domain name format, such as `example.com`. You can register each domain name only once.

description.zh: 域管理员的用户密码。最长支持64个英文字符。
description.en: The password of the domain administrator. The username can be up to 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 域管理员的用户名。最长支持64个英文字符。
description.en: The username of the domain administrator. The username can be up to 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
是否启用MFA认证。开启后，该目录下的所有AD用户登录云电脑时，输入正确密码后，还需输入虚拟MFA设备生成的动态验证码。

> 首次登录时，需绑定MFA设备。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). After you enable MFA, all AD users in the directory must enter a dynamic verification code generated by the virtual MFA device in addition to a correct password when they log on to a cloud computer.

>  When end users log on to a cloud computer for the first time, they must bind an MFA device.

Valid values:

*   true

description.zh: AD域的组织单元OU。您可以调用[ListUserAdOrganizationUnits](~~311259~~)获取。
description.en: The name of the organizational unit (OU) in the AD domain. You can call the ListUserAdOrganizationUnits operation to obtain the name of the OU.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
企业已有AD子域的DNS地址。    
如果设置了`SubDomainName`，而未设置此参数，则认为子域DNS和父域一致。
description.en:
The DNS address of the existing AD subdomain.\
If you specify the `SubDomainName` parameter but you do not specify this parameter, the DNS address of the subdomain is the same as the DNS address of the parent domain.

description.zh: 企业已有AD子域的域名称。
description.en: The domain name of the existing AD subdomain.

descriptions.zh: 仅支持状态为错误（ERROR）或者注册中（REGISTERING）的AD目录修改域名和DNS相关参数，包括`DomainName`、`SubDomainName`、`DnsAddress.N`、`SubDomainDnsAddress`。
descriptions.en: You can modify the following domain name- and Domain Name System (DNS)-related parameters only for Active Directory (AD) directories that are in the ERROR or REGISTERING state: `DomainName`, `SubDomainName`, `DnsAddress.N`, and `SubDomainDnsAddress`.
